name: Loman
oneLiner: AI phone agent for restaurants that answers calls around the clock, takes orders and reservations, and sends them into the POS.
bestFor: Independent and multi-unit restaurants, especially high-call-volume pizza and takeout concepts, that miss phone orders during rushes.

updates.text: Partnered with SpotOn so restaurants on SpotOn POS can switch on Loman phone automation from their SpotOn account.
Partnered with Shift4 to offer Loman's voice AI to restaurants across the Shift4 ecosystem.
Joined the Toast Partner Ecosystem; phone orders flow into existing Toast workflows. Loman said its agent was live in more than 1,500 restaurants.

features: Answers every restaurant call 24/7, including several calls at once during rushes
Takes full phone orders and sends them into the POS (Toast, Square, Clover, SpotOn, NCR, Shift4 and others)
Takes card payments over the phone
Answers menu, hours and other common caller questions
Trained on each restaurant's menu during setup

pricing.text: Not published; Starter, Premium and Enterprise tiers are all quoted by sales ('Contact us').

notes: loman.ai could not be fetched; details from Business Wire releases and search snippets. Funding: $3.5M seed led by Next Coast Ventures, Aug 2025. Previously listed prices ($199/month and $399/month plus $149 setup, 600 minutes included) were replaced by contact-us pricing in June 2026 per a third-party tracker, so they are dropped. Toast release date taken from its URL. Dropped from current review: 'the only AI phone agent purpose-built for restaurants', 'goes live in under a day', 'unlimited simultaneous calls' and Aloha/Olo POS sync (not confirmed in this research; Olo was mentioned only by an aggregator). Customer outcomes ('tripled phone orders', '100% of missed calls eliminated') are vendor-reported.
